note: RV spaces at the Bolado Park Event Center (San Benito County fairgrounds, a state agricultural district), 9 mi south of Hollister off CA 25 near Tres Pinos and a short drive from Pinnacles NP. Self-contained rigs only: there are no restrooms. Sites also sell by the week and month, and fairs and events share the grounds. --Claude
summary: Event-center page read: $48/night, $325/week, $790/month by application; 38 spaces (29 full, 50 A); 'call to ask about current openings', weekday business-hours check-in only; no restrooms (showers true -> false). DROP CANDIDATE on the long-stay/discouraging wording. Possible pin move ~240 m.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE - NIGHTLY GUESTS: the operator writes 'Please call (831) 628-3421 to ask about current openings. Weekday business hour check in is required.' - the 'call to see if we have room' pattern (Cavens Landing rule), plus no weekend or evening arrivals. It does post a nightly rate ('The nightly rate is $48') beside 'The weekly rate is $325' and 'The monthly rate is $790 for the full month. Call for an application', so ordinary nights are offered on paper; the share sold nightly is unmeasured (no booking engine). Reviewer decides.

FACILITIES: 'No tent or car camping allowed as restrooms are not available' - stored showers true (derived) is wrong; showers and flush toilets written false. Dump left as stored (the page lets power-and-water sites dump 'if your rig uses biodegradable storage chemicals').
OWNERSHIP: the page is run by the 33rd District Agricultural Association, a California state agency (fair district), stored 'local'. Suggest local -> state; the price gate does not apply either way.

PIN MOVE ~240 m (under 250 m, but the stored pin is on an empty dirt lot by Airline Hwy): 36.77082,-121.30681 -> ~36.7696,-121.3090, the strip west of the creek where imagery shows a row of RVs. Confidence moderate (no site map); elevation to refresh if moved.
